en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large, elegant 19th‑century villa or institutional building on a hillside, with a central square tower and wings on both sides. The structure has a mansard-like roof with dormer windows, classical decorative elements over the windows, and a long veranda or terrace facing the foreground. In front of it is a terraced garden with curved paths, trees without leaves (likely winter or early spring), and retaining walls leading down toward a fenced road with tram or electric poles. In the distant background, there are rolling hills with scattered buildings, including a solitary structure on top of a hill. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image side.
